summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town at home, with Tatters netting the opening goal in the first half. The Bach held firm defensively to secure a clean sheet and three points in what proved to be a battling performance against a resilient visiting side. It's an ideal opening day result for the newly promoted side as they look to make their mark in the Premier Division.
